name: Lieutenant Haggerdin
summary: At the Headland gate, Lieutenant Haggerdin gathers recruits for the Stormpike Guard. He watches the entrance to Alterac Valley and honors Alliance champions who prove their valor against the Frostwolf Clan.

sections.title: Gatekeeper of the Headland
sections.body: At the snowy Headland above the Hillsbrad Foothills, Lieutenant Haggerdin oversees the Alliance muster for its campaign in Alterac Valley. Dwarven banners mark the massive wooden gate. Recruits and veterans gather under his watch before entering the frigid warzone.

sections.title: Voice of the Stormpike Guard
sections.body: Lieutenant Haggerdin serves the Stormpike Expedition, testing warriors who would represent Ironforge and the Grand Alliance in the valley. In trials such as the Proving Grounds, recruits recover banners and relics. As soldiers rise through the Stormpike Guard, Haggerdin grants official commendations, insignias, and rank recognitions.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin is a dwarf officer of the Stormpike Guard. He is stationed at the entrance to Alterac Valley on the Headland in the Alterac Mountains, where he oversees Alliance recruitment and awards battlefield honors.

faq.q: Where can I find Lieutenant Haggerdin?
faq.answer: You can find Lieutenant Haggerdin on the Headland in the northern Alterac Mountains, just outside the portal and gates leading into Alterac Valley.

faq.q: What role does Haggerdin play in the Stormpike Guard?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin is a field liaison and quartermaster officer for the Stormpike Guard. He administers recruitment trials such as the Proving Grounds and awards higher ranks and insignia as Alliance fighters earn standing with the Guard.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: The Stormpike Expedition entered Alterac Valley to excavate ancient relics and dwarven history. Their arrival sparked a fierce territorial conflict with the resident Frostwolf orcs and their Horde allies.

faq.q: Can Horde players interact with Lieutenant Haggerdin?
faq.answer: No. Lieutenant Haggerdin is an active Alliance officer who attacks Horde champions approaching the Headland gate.

faq.q: What is the Proving Grounds trial?
faq.answer: The Proving Grounds is an introductory trial Lieutenant Haggerdin gives prospective Alliance soldiers. It tests their competence and resolve before they commit fully to the war effort in Alterac Valley.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can find Lieutenant Haggerdin outside Alterac Valley. He offers credentials and official honors earned while fighting the Frostwolf Clan.
As a dwarf, you may see Ironforge's determination in Lieutenant Haggerdin, a proud Stormpike officer seeking their titan heritage in Alterac's snowy crags.
As a Horde champion, you face Lieutenant Haggerdin at the Alliance portal into Alterac Valley. He directs reinforcements sent against the Frostwolf orcs.
